mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.mobile, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, b.lastViewTime FROM member_user u INNER JOIN (SELECT user_id, MAX(create_time) AS lastViewTime FROM author_article_pv_logs WHERE article_id = #{articleId} GROUP BY user_id) b ON u.id = b.user_id ORDER BY b.lastViewTime DESC

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.mobile, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, b.lastViewTime FROM member_user u INNER JOIN (SELECT sl.user_id, MAX(sl.create_time) AS lastViewTime FROM share_scan_log sl INNER JOIN share_live_code slc ON sl.share_token = slc.share_token WHERE slc.target_id = #{articleId} AND sl.deleted = 0 AND slc.target_type = 1 AND sl.user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sl.user_id) b ON u.id = b.user_id ORDER BY b.lastViewTime DESC
